title: Architecture investigation notebook
prompt: Create an architecture investigation notebook with at least 7 cells and a 12-node AWS workflow. Use the supplied node descriptions, real matching bundled AWS icons and status badges. Keep nodes readable by default; provide Fit overview and Focus selected actions. Selecting a node by clicking or selector updates a detail inspector with tabs for Summary (Markdown), Properties (JSON), and highlighted SQL/JSON example (code). A local incident note persists between tabs. A health selector (All/Ready/Warning) highlights matching nodes without removing the topology. Include an independently zoomable Mermaid request sequence, a table of services with an Inspect action that selects/focuses the same node, an evidence carousel and full-width operational guide. Flow and Mermaid each open in a canvas-only new tab preserving current view. Export selected id and notes. Sidebar links scroll. Use supplied graph data without backend claims. Use the supplied variant topology and descriptions, not the recipe topology. Keep the graph readable and retained state correct while emphasizing health and selecting distant services.
